title: Natural invertible normalized open projection
statement: Under the hypotheses of the open-piece existence theorem, there exists a natural transformation p from openTensorTarget to openTensorSource whose components are the adjunction-transposed maps openTensorProjectionComponent and are all isomorphisms.

proof.text: Construct the adjunction-transposed map on each pair (E,F). Naturality follows from the adjunction hom-equivalence, functoriality of tensor models, and naturality of the restriction-tensor comparison. For strict-perfect F, the finite-free retract, signed finite totalization, K-flat resolution, and derived descent prove each component is invertible.
